sorting_rule: SHA256(UTF8('AF-RES-102|ggplot2|'+relative_page+'#'+fragment)) ascending; first 40 eligible pages in lexical relative-page order; do not expand beyond the first40 for change strata.
exposures: new release metadata including source SHA, release description, event dates (not rendered examples)
new publication git-commit metadata: source SHA message, parent/tree SHA, author/date; no new tree, body, image or CI logs opened
source_mapping_rule: man/<page basename>.Rd is rendered reference body input; exact old paths/blob IDs frozen before new source tree. R author links are context only.
prefetch_note: To parallelize old-page requests, first 75 old reference paths excluding inherited 2 were received; frame itself stops at the 40th eligible (geom_histogram). Seven later old pages through geom_qq were received opaquely but not used or counted in stage1.
